text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the classroom, I could hear Special Week and
Tokai Teio chatting cheerfully...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And then, Suzuka-san back then
was just so, sooo cool and amazing, desu ne~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I hear ya~ You're head over heels
for Suzuka as always, Spe-chan~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because Suzuka-san is my idol! I want to
become a wonderful Umamusume just like her, desu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But I don't really know what to do concretely to get there... Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't everything start with looking the part~?
If you mimic her, your inner self will surely become like hers too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I see... I'll try it out right away!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Fufun~ How's this, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! Suzuka would strike a much
more graceful pose, and she wouldn't say "fufun"!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: H-How about like this, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, like that! Looking good, looking good~!
Alright, now do the Teio Step!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! Teio Ste—wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding♪ But why not spend some time
acting like Suzuka just like that?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chaaan!
What perfect timing, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I found a delicious taco shop!
How about we go together on the way back today, desu?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh, El-chan.
Ehehe, looking energetic today as... well, are you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A delicious taco shop... Yes,
I find that intriguing.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
? You're talking kind of weird, desu...
Did you headbutt a wall in your sleep or something, desu?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No. Tacos, how lovely. Of course
I will go with you, but please leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
G-Go together, but leave you alone??
I really don't get what you're saying—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I want to go. To the other side
of delicious tacos that no one has ever seen.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, where do you think you're going, desu?!
What do you mean, "the other side of tacos"?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Please wait, Spe-chaaan?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Special Week persistently
continued her impression of Silence Suzuka.
